headline: Archipelago saves remember their rooms; Difficulty fixes Blarg Station
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0 remembers the room belonging to each memory-card slot and refuses another seed's save, alongside logic and reconnect fixes (#24, #26). Difficulty v1.2.4 fixes the missing ship and Clank on Blarg Station at enemy count 2 by leaving space for the level's own spawns (#34). Item Randomizer v1.0.4 also shipped; all three releases were built against Mod SDK 1.11.0.
highlights: Players can help test Archipelago and randomizer logic in #25, including whether Drek and gold bolts on return Veldin, Aridia and Batalia can be reached without the Trespasser.
Difficulty's Blarg Station budget reserves 193 more object slots; its pool of 255 consequently gets no enemy copies (#34).
The index now rebuilds after releases, reports publishing failures and recovery, and records AI assistance per mod (#21, #27, #33).
Listing checks handle unchanged submissions and missing repositories, and reject an unlistable newest release instead of silently offering an older one (#30, #32).
Co-op crossplay, shared saves and host takeover remain in draft #22, not merged.
